title: A Full-Spectrum Generative Lead Discovery (FSGLD) pipeline via DRUG-GAN: A multiscale method for drug-like/target-specific compound library generation.
summary: The generative pipeline produced candidates for experimental screening; the primary preprint reports one tested candidate with measured CB2 binding, while the journal version also reports HER4 work. This supports a narrow initial-hit result, not a validated therapeutic.
ai_technology: Journal Methods/Results and the Research Square v1 PDF establish the generative operation, screening workflow, nine-compound assay and limited CB2 binding result; preprint posted 2025-05-12.
organization: Department of Pharmaceutical Sciences and Computational Chemical Genomics Screening Center, School of Pharmacy, University of Pittsburgh, Pittsburgh, PA 15261, USA.; Hangzhou Institute of Medicine, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Hangzhou, 310018 Zhejiang, China.; School of Medicine, Shanghai University, 200444 Shanghai, China.
